operator.name: Chalet Skilled Nursing Facility LLC
operator.role_label: Licensed operating entity (CMS legal business name)

top_deficiency_types.title: Reasonably accommodate the needs and preferences of each resident.
Ensure food and drink is palatable, attractive, and at a safe and appetizing temperature.
Ensure that a nursing home area is free from accident hazards and provides adequate supervision to prevent accidents.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide pharmaceutical services to meet the needs of each resident and employ or obtain the services of a licensed pharmacist.
Provide appropriate care for residents who are continent or incontinent of bowel/bladder, appropriate catheter care,  and appropriate care  to prevent urinary tract infections.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Safeguard resident-identifiable information and/or maintain medical records on each resident that are in accordance with accepted professional standards.
top_deficiency_types.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide and implement an infection prevention and control program.
Protect each resident from all types of abuse such as physical, mental, sexual abuse, physical punishment, and neglect by anybody.
top_deficiency_types.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide enough nursing staff every day to meet the needs of every resident; and have a licensed nurse in charge on each shift.

Ensure drugs and biologicals used in the facility are labeled in accordance with currently accepted professional principles; and all drugs and biologicals must be stored in locked compartments, separately locked, compartments for controlled drugs.
